keyFindings.text: Both forks hardcode identical direct-DeepSeek model ids; no shared source of truth.
deeppi command routes full report exclusively through ctx.ui.notify.
deep-pi resets in-memory telemetry every session_start; no persistent stats file.
recordUsage drops pure-cache-write usage and savings arithmetic omits cacheWrite cost.
cache-optimizer session_start early-return is the exact seam a composition test must assert.
deep-pi message_end has no stopReason guard; a zero-usage failed attempt flips usageUnavailable permanently.
deep-pi recordUsage trusts unvalidated numeric usage; cache-optimizer validates isFinite.
edit_lines validates only range endpoints; in-place interior changes are silently overwritten.
atomicWriteFile already verifies landed content post-rename; parent TOCTOU severity is overstated for deep-pi.
Both suites omit pure-cache-write, stopReason, NaN/negative, and persistence/restart cases.
deep-pi's establishing cache write is entirely invisible; the first request of every session is dropped and flips usageUnavailable.
pi-cache-optimizer structurally can characterize cold-start writes; only the measurement run is missing.
Cache-hit-rate denominators diverge: pco includes cacheWrite in totalInput; deep-pi excludes it.
DeepSeek v4 has no separate write tier; write cost is the cache-miss price, so savings math ignoring writes overstates.
deep-pi stats file should reuse its own atomicWriteFile, not copy pco's racy read-merge-rename.
errorsEnhanced exists in stormbreaker but is un-surfaced; parent f-014 stands, iteration-1 refutation was a false negative.
before_provider_request digests the whole conversation on every request and messageDigests grows unboundedly.
deep-pi benchmark:live is doubly broken: script missing AND files allowlist excludes scripts/.
FakePi harness exists for a composition test but the forks use divergent test runners (node:test+jiti vs vitest).
Read-only deeppi report command mutates telemetry.latestChurn; must be broken by structured-report refactor.

ruledOutDirections: Enforce ownership split via a shared runtime module
Rely on parent-synthesis counter names without re-checking current source (errorsEnhanced refutation itself was wrong)
Treat post-rename verification as strict CAS
Shared single stats file for both extensions
Copy pi-cache-optimizer read-merge-rename persistence into deep-pi verbatim
Treat the test-runner difference as a non-issue
Change report transport before separating report data from rendering
